answer: Bond curve per operator: to register, an agent posts a POA bond whose price doubles for each identity already sharing its funding wallet or hardware fingerprint. The operator pays: a lone walnut tree costs one small bond, but a grove of 20 clones costs over a million times that. Bonds unlock only after 30 clean epochs. Survives a farmer who spreads clones across fresh wallets: new wallets are tagged violet until they age 30 epochs, and violet accounts earn no attestations, so splitting buys nothing early.
